title: Project P.I.T.T. Secret Ending Guide — END?, Elevator Code & Route
description: Reach the Secret Ending (END?), why 2640 may fail, how the save-specific UV-based code works and the Duck→Cash Register→Piñata→Anomaly entry order.
h1: Project P.I.T.T. Secret Ending Guide — END?, Elevator Code & Route
quickAnswer: Why doesn’t 2640 work? 2640 is not a universal code; current players report 2640 does not work. END? is the Secret Ending. The four-digit elevator/keypad code comes from UV clues in your own save; the digits correspond to the four manual production machines and must be entered in machine-unlock order: Duck → Cash Register → Piñata → Anomaly.

facts.label: END? meaning
facts.value: END? is the Secret Ending in Project P.I.T.T., unlocked after completing the full hidden route and entering the save-specific code; treat END? as the secret outcome distinct from other ending labels.

facts.label: Route
facts.value: Verified full-release progression: camera/surveillance progression → upper exploration → Mystery Boxes → 3 Fuses → 200kg → Percentage Pipe → later minigame/production progression → UV-related clue progression → elevator access/keycard → save-specific four-digit keypad code → Secret Ending route.

facts.label: Code
facts.value: The four-digit Secret Ending keypad code is tied to the current save. Use UV to reveal four digits in your save; the digits correspond to the four manual production machines. Enter them in machine-unlock order: Duck → Cash Register → Piñata → Anomaly. 2640 was reported from one specific playthrough but is not universal and many players report 2640 does not work.

facts.label: Keypad troubleshooting
facts.value: Why doesn’t 2640 work? Because the code is save-specific. If the keypad or elevator is unavailable, check that you completed required Keycard steps, found the UV clues in your save, and finished prerequisite progression (camera/surveillance, Mystery Boxes, 3 Fuses, 200kg, Percentage Pipe, production progression). Return to the last completed progression stage rather than guessing public codes. FAQ: Why does 2640 not work? It was from one save only. Is the elevator code the same for everyone? No—it's save-specific. Where do I find the four Secret Ending digits? They are revealed by UV clues tied to your playthrough. What order do I enter the digits? Duck → Cash Register → Piñata → Anomaly. Why can’t I use the keypad yet? You likely need to finish Keycard, UV, or other prerequisite progression steps first.
